# Broadcaster — First-Pass Delta

The Awtsmoos reveals when a clean control vessel has quietly grown too wide;
Awtsmoos.com splits action from advanced revelation, keeping neither cramped nor denied.

## Planned

Rewrite one clean controls stylesheet to add pressed states, fine-pointer hover scoping, disabled feedback, advanced disclosure interaction, checkbox theming, and reduced motion.

## Actual

Behavioral contract tests still pass 7/7 and source contains the requested active + scoped-hover behavior. However the whole `controls.css` reached 155 lines, violating the <=120-line source law. The first browser geometry harness also failed before collecting viewport evidence because its Node-side settle helper mistakenly called browser-only `requestAnimationFrame` outside the CDP evaluation context.

Neither issue is a production layout failure. One is architectural debt created by this pass; the other is a test harness error.

## Second-pass correction

- Rewrite `styles/controls.css` completely to own action-row, action button, status indicator, mobile action layout, action hover/active/focus/disabled, and action reduced-motion behavior only.
- Create `styles/advanced-controls.css` to own the folded Advanced disclosure, checkbox, kbd hint, summary hover/active/focus, and its reduced-motion behavior.
- Import Advanced controls from `controls.css` so the existing stylesheet graph and HTML stay unchanged.
- Rerun line/long-line/diff tests.
- Rerun the CDP geometry probe using a simple bounded sleep after CSS readiness, never Node-side `requestAnimationFrame`.
